items.text: Official or co-official languages here: Akateko, Awakatek, Chuj, Jakaltek, Mam, Q’anjob’al.

languages.notes: Signals until the place's own language law and census are read.

festivals: Todos Santos Cuchumatán: CONAP describes 1 November (All Saints) celebrations with a horse race and Baile de la Conquista. This is a description of a recurring local celebration, not confirmation of a future programme or consent to attend/film.
closures: Parque Regional Municipal K’Ojlab’L Tze´ Te Tnom Todos Santos Cuchumatán: Monday-Sunday 08:00-17:00. CONAP recommends contacting the Chiabal village tourism committee and park administration before visiting for services.
